publicTitle: Do the Safeguards Earn Their Cost?
question: Which safeguards actually change an operational result, and which merely add ceremony?
inputs: frozen Gen448 sidecar at four authentic host boundaries B0–B3
CLEAN and M1–M8 cases at each boundary; 36 cases per configuration
252 arm-cases; identical scientific information across configurations
comparator: Completed Gen449 comparison against the frozen BASELINE arm and five single-component removals; differentiation is bounded to the tested workload and comparator.
procedure: evaluate each named safeguard under source-native operational criteria
retain positive negative and unevaluable outcomes separately
assess composed architecture without converting operational evidence into scientific support
environment: Repository-operational test surface; public reproduction may use a neutral reference implementation preserving the same semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Mixed component dispositions must be retained exactly; operational distinction must not be represented as scientific authority.
verifier: Independent bounded operational recomputation against the public method/result record.
knownGaps: general superiority over other control architectures unestablished
proprietaryBoundary: The public target is the operational contract, component dispositions and acceptance criteria; complete private control-plane implementation is not required.
claimCeiling: Operational differentiation against the frozen Gen449 baseline within one bounded repository-operation profile; no scientific or automatic product authority, cross-repository transfer, production-scale benefit, universal enforcement, or general superiority beyond the tested workload and comparator.

boundedComparison.costInterpretation: Mean checks and serialized decision bytes only; not wall-clock latency, memory use, or production cost.

componentRemovalFindings.NEWS: loss of exact M2 semantic-order response
componentRemovalFindings.ACK_PACK: loss of M5 corruption handling; exact recovery returns to baseline
componentRemovalFindings.PSALM: no loss in next-action, recovery, or invalid-detection endpoints
componentRemovalFindings.FIBONACCI_HOST_UTILITY: no genuine unresolved source/capability condition; live-host utility unevaluable
